# Voice PRO AI

> Voice PRO AI is a Windows desktop application for Russian voice dictation, audio/video transcription, text post-processing, and local/API speech workflows.

## Official site
- https://voiceproai.ru/

## Download
- https://github.com/dencikpapinka-png/ai-voice-pro-ai/releases/latest/download/Voice_PRO_AI_Setup.exe
